angle: Earns smoothing by letting a repeated-word spam message break on a zero count before repairing it with added counts, instead of introducing the classifier as prior-times-likelihood alone.
angle_detail: Begin at [01:25] for the word-histogram likelihoods, then [04:34] where priors multiply into the short-message decision. The key stretch is [09:00] to [10:55], where the unseen-word zero wipes out the spam score until smoothing near [12:29] fixes it. Note likelihood here just means per-word class probability, interchangeable with probability in this video unlike the course usage.
